Reshaping to Game Level

gameLong is the workhorse: one row per participant per week per game.

Entering Weekly Winners

The matchups are read straight out of the data, so no schedule needs to be typed by hand. On the first run of a new week, a new sheet (“Week N”) is appended to Winners/winners.xlsx with blank rows for that week’s games — fill in the Winner column there (exact team name, matching Team1 or Team2) and re-render. Existing sheets and entries are never overwritten.
